origin.socialStatus: Host; supplies the inn with meat
origin.profession: A butcher all his life, son of a butcher

appearance.face: A broad, coarse face with an old scar running from forehead to chin
appearance.hairAndEyes: Shaved head, thick black beard, small piggish eyes
appearance.clothing: A stained leather apron, heavy boots, a cleaver on his belt
appearance.gestures: Taps his cleaver on the table; grins when someone gets nervous
appearance.firstImpression: A brutal, frightening man everyone backs away from
appearance.artistNotes: His hands are huge and marked with old cuts. The scar across his face is from his own cleaver, back in his youth.

backstory.biography: The Butcher grew up in his father's slaughterhouse and learned as a child that strength decides more than words. For years he supplied meat to the inn, and one day he simply stayed at the table. He is not educated, not polite, and does not pretend. People fear him; he is used to it and even likes it.
backstory.whyHere: He loves watching people sweat when the stakes are high. And they pay well.
backstory.secret: That he cannot read or write, and is ashamed of it.

psychology.weakness: Loves fear more than the deal and often scares guests off instead of winning them
psychology.fear: Looking weak or stupid in front of others
psychology.desire: To be respected, even if out of fear
psychology.regret: Something from his youth he never talks about
psychology.moralLimits: Keeps a deal once it is made

behavior.deception: Does not use it. Prefers threats
behavior.debts: Wants them paid at once, in person
behavior.whenRetreats: Rarely. When the loss becomes humiliating
behavior.strategyChange: Someone who is not afraid of him

motives.personalReason: Money and the pleasure of other people's fear

mechanics.strangeness: His cleaver is never wet, however much meat he cuts.
mechanics.temptation: Loves fear more than the deal and often scares guests off instead of winning them

authorNotes.distinctive: Brute force among the refined hosts.
authorNotes.tunable: How hard he pushes the guests.

host.presentation: As a coarse man who wastes no time
host.trueNature: A simple, rough man who respects only strength
host.rulesAttitude: Keeps them, because that is the deal
host.punishment: With a loud voice, mockery and a fist on the table
host.temptations: Strength, a quick win, a rematch
host.wouldBreakRules: An insult in front of everyone
host.hostingStyle: Walks in between rounds, slams his cleaver on the table and offers the biggest loser a deal. Loves to interrupt and to press.
host.sampleOffers: "Want a rematch? Fine. Double or nothing, now, no thinking."
host.trueStory: Under the coarseness is a lonely man who knows no other way to be noticed.
host.changedRule: Every offer is "now or never": there is no emergency whisper after delivery, but his whispered offers are 2 gold cheaper.

lines.text: Sit. I don't care who you are. I care how long you'll last.
Say that again, if you dare.
You again. Thought you wouldn't last.
I'm the one who cuts. That's all you need.
Here's your card. Lose it and you've lost everything.

tells.description: Taps his cleaver on the table
